content: Obesity is a recognized risk factor for the development of various cancers, including those of the breast, colon, and gynecological regions. Recent studies have not only established a correlation between obesity and carcinogenesis, but also identified a significant impact of obesity on patient prognoses across several types of cancer. For instance, obesity has been linked to a less favorable prognosis for breast and colon cancer patients. Conversely, obese patients diagnosed with gastric or renal cancers have been observed to show a more favorable prognosis.
